# Exact known-failure baseline from main/PR #2463 on Python 3.11.

# The CI runner accepts only these existing failures. A new failure, an error
# that changes category, or a malformed/duplicate entry fails the job. When a
# test is repaired it disappears from the observed set and is reported as a
# resolved baseline entry so this file can be ratcheted down.
# A small number of method/module separators use URL encoding because
# TruffleHog v3.96.0's Lob detector misclassifies 40-character Python test
# identifiers as verified credentials. The runner decodes them before matching.
